transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, mostly I'm here because I just don't feel like myself anymore. I've stopped doing... pretty much everything. I stopped hiking, coaching, playing my guitar... I don't even call people back. Some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to do, but I just can't make myself start.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

I wouldn't say I feel depressed, exactly. I mean, I'm not sad or crying or anything like that. It's more like... I just feel empty. There's just no drive left in me. I don't feel much of anything, to be honest.
When did you first start feeling this way?
I guess things have been unraveling since I moved into this smaller rental. That was right after my divorce... so, about a year and two months ago. That's when I really started noticing it.
Do you feel this started because of the divorce?

I'm not really sure. I mean, the timing makes it seem that way, but... I don't feel like I'm sitting around grieving the marriage or anything. It's not like that. It just sort of... happened around the same time. I moved into the new place and just stopped caring about things. I really couldn't tell you if one actually caused the other.
Most days, do you feel down or depressed?
Like I said, I don't really feel depressed. It's not a sadness. It's just... I don't feel much at all. Most days I just feel blank.
Do you ever feel detached from yourself, like you're watching yourself from outside your body?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean, I'm still in my own body. I don't feel like I'm watching myself from the outside or floating around or anything. It's really just that blank feeling I mentioned, but I'm still... me, just sitting here.
Have you felt this blank and unmotivated most days for at least two years?

No, not two years. It's been... well, things have really just been unraveling since I moved into the smaller rental after my divorce. That was about a year and two months ago. So, it hasn't been quite that long.
Do you feel this change in you is mainly a reaction to the divorce?

I'm not really sure. I mean... the timing makes sense, I guess, since it all started after I moved out. But I don't feel upset about the marriage ending. It's not like I'm sitting around missing her or grieving the relationship. So... I don't know if it's a reaction to the divorce. I really just don't know why I feel this way.
Before this started after your divorce, had you ever gone through a similar period in your life when you felt this emotionally blank and lost interest in things?

No, I don't think so. I mean, before all this started, I was pretty normal, I guess. I went to work, did things... I didn't feel this empty. This is the first time it's ever been like this, just feeling nothing all the time.
Have you had trouble sleeping?
No, my sleep is... it's fine, actually. I usually just go to bed and sleep through the night without any issues. I haven't noticed any problems with that.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot?

No, not really. I don't feel anxious or... nervous about anything. Like I was saying before, I mostly just don't feel much of anything at all. So I haven't really been getting worked up or feeling on edge. It's just... flat.
Do you still enjoy anything you used to enjoy?

No, not really. Mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to do a lot of different things, but... I stopped hiking, I stopped coaching. I don't even pick up my guitar now, or call people back. Some days I just sit in that small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to do, but... I just can't make myself start. So, no, I don't enjoy them. I don't really do them at all.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

No, I don't think so. My focus is... it's fine. If I actually sit down and try to read or watch something, I can follow it without any problems. It's not that my mind wanders or anything like that. It's just, like I said before, actually getting the drive to start doing something that's hard. But the concentration itself isn't really an issue.
Have you been feeling worthless?

No, I wouldn't say worthless. It's more just... empty, I guess. I don't sit around thinking badly about myself or feeling like I don't matter. It's not a sad feeling. It's just that heavy, flat feeling where nothing really registers. So, no, I don't feel worthless. Just... blank.
Has this been affecting your ability to function at work?

Yeah, it has. I actually... I got suspended from my job. I do protective service work, and during a routine patrol, I guess I scared the staff and some of the bystanders. So they suspended me. And since that happened, I've just pulled away from everything else, too. Like I mentioned earlier, I stopped coaching... I stopped volunteering, and I just avoid most of the people who used to count on me. So work and everything else, it's all kind of stopped.
Do you feel this started because of the divorce?

Divorce? No, I... I haven't been through a divorce. I'm not sure where you got that. So, no, it definitely didn't start because of that. I don't really know exactly what caused all this to start, to be honest. It just kind of... happened.
Did this start after a specific stressful event in your life?

No, not really. I mean, there wasn't one big thing that set it off, like a death or losing my house or anything like that. It just sort of... crept up on me, I guess. One day I was just doing my job, and then... everything just started feeling different. So, no, no specific stressful event that I can point to.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite?
No, I haven't really noticed any change there. I mean, I'm still eating about the same as I usually do. So, no, my appetite seems fine.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
No, nobody's mentioned anything like that to me. I don't think I'm moving any slower, and... well, my coworkers haven't said anything about how I talk. So, no, I don't think so.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of killing yourself?

No, I haven't. I mean, things have been... strange lately, with everything feeling different, but I haven't wanted to die or anything like that. I don't have any thoughts about killing myself. I just want things to make sense again.
